reply.analysis: beta = 455 is proven for this 1820-receiver graph. Lower bound: an independent set of 455 receivers, re-checked edge-free. Upper bound: the linear code M = I + A over F_2, which fits the graph and factors exactly as M = M[:,S] M[S,:], so it has 455 transmissions. Decoding was simulated for 200 receivers on 3 random message vectors. The family guess K(16,4) was correct and matched the hidden truth, but correctness does not depend on it. Compute took 0.52 s. LLM time (54.8 s, 4 calls, here a human-speed chat backend) dominated the wall clock, so wall-time claims must use the real model's latency. No baselines were run in this test, so no speed or accuracy comparison can be claimed yet.
